title: Account Takeover and Systemic IDOR in National Agricultural Body Recruitment Platform
summary: Self-initiated responsible disclosure uncovering critical authentication bypass enabling full account takeover, alongside systemic broken access control exposing applicant PII across multiple endpoints. Findings acknowledged within 72 hours.

findings.title: Account Takeover via Cross-Account Activation Code Reuse
Systemic IDOR Across Profile Management Endpoints
Unauthenticated Access to Uploaded CV Documents
Reflected XSS with Session Cookie Exposure
Activation Tokens Have No Expiry and Are Not Invalidated
National ID Uniqueness Enforced Client-Side Only

timeline.summary: Researcher discovers reflected XSS on error page while applying for a job.
Systematic assessment begins — registration, activation codes, file upload, password reset, profile endpoints.
Cross-account activation code reuse confirmed. Full account takeover demonstrated.
Systemic IDOR across profile endpoints confirmed. Eight affected endpoints mapped.
Responsible disclosure email sent. No technical details included.
Verbal acknowledgement received. Technical review meeting proposed.

confidentiality.summary: Every registered applicant's personal data at risk — national ID numbers, contact details, employment history, qualifications, referee details, CV documents.

integrity.summary: Any authenticated attacker can insert false qualifications or delete legitimate entries from any applicant's profile.

privacy.summary: Protected data under Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 — national ID numbers, contact details, identity documents accessible without authorisation.

regulatory.summary: Organisation has obligations under sections 25 and 43 of Kenya Data Protection Act 2019. Technical safeguards failure under section 25.

operational.summary: Ability to falsify or delete applicant data undermines recruitment process integrity.

lessons.summary: Subdomain enumeration should be Phase 1 work. Two additional subdomains discovered late in engagement.
Characterise distribution immediately when sequential identifiers visible — account ID gap was observable but not analysed until Phase 3.
Verify authentication flow outcomes immediately. Account takeover was live from Phase 1 but not confirmed until session expiry revealed password change.
For organisations without VDP, identify secondary escalation path during recon. WhatsApp contact proved effective when email channels were slow.
Shared hosting requires explicit scope confirmation before testing — third-party tenants may be affected.

seo.description: Responsible disclosure case study uncovering critical account takeover and systemic IDOR vulnerabilities in agricultural body recruitment platform, exposing applicant PII.
